entities.summary: Gwangju Uprising and Fifth Republic, a transformative movement in South Korea (1980–1987). Emerged from Fifth Republic and Gwangju Uprising — martial law troops kill hundreds of pro-democracy protesters. Catalyzed June Democracy Movement forces democratic concessions and June 29 Declaration.
